disgusting--adj.def: Extremely unpleasant to see, smell or taste.
disgusting--adj.ex: The water had a disgusting smell.

neighborhood--noun.def: The area of a town around where you live.

march--verb.def: To walk with regular steps, often as a group.
march--verb.ex: The soldiers marched through the square.

aside--adv.def: To one side, or kept for later.
aside--adv.ex: She put some money aside each month.
aside--adv.exTr: Her ay bir kenara biraz para koydu.

mail--verb.def: To send a letter or a package by post.

violence--noun.def: Behaviour that is meant to hurt people.

firm--adj.def: Solid and not easily moved, or not likely to change.

firm--noun.def: A business company, often of lawyers or engineers.
firm--noun.ex: She joined a law firm in Ankara.

available--adj.def: Able to be used or obtained, or free to meet.

central--adj.def: In the middle of a place, or most important.

union--noun.def: An organization of workers, or a group of states.
union--noun.ex: The union asked for higher pay.

studio--noun.def: A room where an artist works or a programme is recorded.
studio--noun.ex: The album was made in a small studio.

iron--noun.def: A strong grey metal, or a tool for pressing clothes.
iron--noun.ex: The gate is made of iron.

iron--verb.def: To make clothes smooth with a hot tool.
iron--verb.ex: He irons his shirts on Sundays.

desire--noun.ex: She had a real desire to learn.
desire--noun.exTr: Öğrenmek için gerçek bir arzusu vardı.

miracle--noun.def: A wonderful event that seems impossible.

christian--adj.def: Relating to the religion based on Jesus Christ.
christian--adj.ex: The town has two Christian churches.

protection--noun.def: The act of keeping someone or something safe.

treatment--noun.def: Medical care, or the way you deal with someone.

rescue--noun.def: The act of saving someone from danger.

rescue--verb.def: To save someone from a dangerous situation.

capable--adj.def: Having the ability or the skill to do something.
capable--adj.ex: She is capable of much better work.
capable--adj.exTr: Çok daha iyi iş çıkarabilecek durumda.

result--verb.def: To happen because of something else.
result--verb.ex: The delay resulted in extra costs.

governor--noun.def: The official who governs a state or a province.
governor--noun.ex: The governor visited the flooded villages.
governor--noun.exTr: Vali su basan köyleri ziyaret etti.

remove--verb.def: To take something away from a place.

scream--verb.def: To make a loud high cry of fear or pain.
scream--verb.ex: The child screamed at the sight.

vehicle--noun.def: A machine such as a car or a bus that carries people.

unbelievable--adj.def: Too surprising or extreme to be believed.

curious--adj.def: Wanting to know something, or slightly strange.

edge--noun.def: The outer part of something, where it ends.

boom--noun.def: A deep loud sound, or a period of fast growth.
boom--noun.ex: The city saw a building boom.

former--adj.def: Having had a position in the past.

penny--noun.def: A small British or American coin.
penny--noun.ex: It did not cost a penny.

claim--noun.def: A statement that something is true, or a demand.

desperate--adj.def: Ready to do anything because the situation is very bad.
desperate--adj.ex: They were desperate for clean water.

dramatic--adj.def: Sudden and easy to notice, or full of strong feeling.
dramatic--adj.ex: There was a dramatic change in temperature.

refuse--noun.def: Waste material that is thrown away.
refuse--noun.ex: The refuse is collected on Fridays.

refuse--verb.def: To say firmly that you will not do something.
refuse--verb.ex: She refused to sign the paper.

properly--adv.def: In the correct or suitable way.

directly--adv.def: Without anything or anyone in between.

surface--noun.def: The outside or top layer of something.
surface--noun.ex: Wipe the surface with a cloth.

warn--verb.def: To tell someone about a possible danger.
warn--verb.ex: They warned us about the ice.

fallen--adj.def: Having come down to the ground.

presence--noun.def: The fact of being in a place.

tear--verb.def: To pull paper or cloth apart so it breaks.
tear--verb.ex: He tore the letter in half.

coast--verb.def: To move forward without using power or effort.
coast--verb.ex: The car coasted down the hill.
coast--verb.exTr: Araba yokuş aşağı kendi kendine kaydı.

exchange--verb.def: To give one thing and receive another.

convince--verb.def: To make someone believe or agree.

beast--noun.ex: The story describes a wild beast.

drag--verb.def: To pull something heavy along the ground.
drag--verb.ex: They dragged the boat onto the sand.

ordinary--adj.def: Normal and not special in any way.
ordinary--adj.ex: It was an ordinary working day.

shift--verb.def: To move something to a different position.
shift--verb.ex: Shift the sofa a little left.

direct--verb.def: To manage a film or a group, or to show the way.
direct--verb.ex: She directed her first film last year.

score--noun.def: The number of points in a game or a test.

score--verb.def: To get a point in a game or a test.
score--verb.ex: He scored in the last minute.

series--noun.def: A number of similar events or programmes in order.

darkness--noun.def: The state of having no light.

cure--noun.def: Something that makes an illness go away.

rare--adj.ex: This bird is rare in Turkey.

explosion--noun.def: A sudden violent bursting with a loud noise.

prisoner--noun.def: A person kept in a prison or held by an enemy.

pie--noun.def: A dish of pastry filled with meat or fruit.

pot--noun.def: A deep round container for cooking or for plants.
pot--noun.ex: Boil the water in a large pot.

parking--noun.def: The act of leaving a vehicle, or the space for it.

ambulance--noun.def: A vehicle that takes ill people to hospital.

progress--noun.def: Movement towards a better or later state.

county--noun.def: An area of local government in Britain or America.

vision--noun.def: The ability to see, or an idea about the future.
vision--noun.ex: His vision for the city was bold.

equipment--noun.def: The tools or machines needed for an activity.

mass--adj.def: Involving a very large number of people.

defend--verb.def: To protect someone, or to argue in support of them.

trace--noun.def: A small sign that something existed.
trace--noun.ex: There was no trace of the keys.

dump--noun.def: A place where waste is left.
dump--noun.ex: The old tyres went to the dump.

dump--verb.def: To get rid of something carelessly.
dump--verb.ex: Do not dump oil in the river.

emperor--noun.def: The male ruler of an empire.
emperor--noun.ex: The emperor ruled for forty years.
